description: This Java class defines a custom bottom sheet dialog for managing quick sharing permissions in the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It provides UI components and logic to display and modify sharing permissions for files or folders, integrating with the OCShare resource and handling user interactions.

classes.name: QuickSharingPermissionsBottomSheetDialog
classes.description: A custom bottom sheet dialog for managing quick sharing permissions, allowing users to select and modify permissions for shared files or folders.

methods.name: QuickSharingPermissionsBottomSheetDialog
methods.description: Constructor initializing the dialog with activity context, actions callback, and OCShare object.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the dialog UI, sets layout, and configures the RecyclerView for permission options.

methods.name: setUpRecyclerView
methods.description: Prepares the RecyclerView with permission options and sets the adapter.

methods.name: handlePermissionChanged
methods.description: Handles user permission changes, updates the OCShare permissions accordingly, and dismisses the dialog.

methods.name: getQuickPermissionList
methods.description: Generates the list of permission options to display based on the OCShare object.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the dialog is stopped.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies branding styles to the dialog UI.
